ModulePrefs.title: LOLlookangSLS
ModulePrefs.author: weelookang@gmail.com
ModulePrefs.description: LOL diagrams are a way to represent how the energy is stored in the chosen system during various snapshots and to represent any changes in total energy for the system. Each “L” represents how the energy is stored during a particular snapshot (instant). The “O” shows the objects inside and outside the system.
